title: DOW-UAP-D57, Range Fouler Reporting Form, Gulf of Aden, September 2020
doc_notes: This document is a U.S. Navy Range Fouler Reporting Form detailing a UAP encounter in the Gulf of Aden, containing some redacted location information.

incidents.summary: A U.S. military operator tracked a round, cold object over the Gulf of Aden via IR sensor for eight minutes.
behavior: made a few abrupt directional changes
incidents.quote: we tracked a round, cold object in IR traveling 168 degrees at 277 mph
